card.name: Inside titles of laws and reports
card.fires_on: Linking words or word parts inside long official titles, such as 'for other purposes', 'laying down the', 'respecting ... and the', or the middle of a report title. It fires where a title is partway through and a topic phrase follows.

modes.label: Legal act titles
modes.description: Linking words inside the long title of a law, act, or regulation.
modes.example: and<< for>> other purposes. Equal Pay Act of

modes.label: Regulation phrasing
modes.description: Words like 'laying down' or 'respecting' that introduce what a law covers.
modes.example: 20 October 2010 laying down<< the>> obligations of operators who place timber and timber

modes.label: Report or guideline titles
modes.description: Words inside the titles of cited reports or papers.
modes.example: Expert Panel on Blood Cholesterol<< Levels>> in Children and Adolescents. Pediatrics .
